name: Natsuhi Hikaru
source:
Third year student from "Sun Academy" - the "official" side of  Saint Solyluna Academy. She's the student council president, and one of the main candidate for this year's μ. Object of worshiping and much respect.  

Sister of Natsuhi Mitsu, but for some reasons acted cold toward her.
